name: MicroTap

overview.text: MicroTap presents pay-per-call APIs for market, web and blockchain data, advertised at $0.01 to $0.05 per request in USDC through x402 on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum and Solana. Its Protocol Pulse panel explicitly shows ecosystem-wide activity via agentic.market, not MicroTap revenue or usage. Try-it examples are marked simulated with no payment sent. This is paid tool access, not a bounty or earnings offer.
